messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to enable enterprise allowlist for acme-prod tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need a short rollback + SLA checklist before we flip.

maria: Do we have a clear SLA impact if we hit a regression during canary?

sam: SLA itself shouldn't change, but error-rate alerts might spike. Recommend temporary alert suppression + notify support channel.

lee: +1. I'll prepare the alert suppression window (15m before -> 30m after) and add a trace tag.

tanvi: I'll draft a rollback runbook now. Minimal steps: 1) flip flag off, 2) revert route rule, 3) scale down reserved pool, 4) notify customers. I'll add the exact CLI commands.

alex: Can we also ensure audit logs capture who triggered the flag? We need forensic trace for contracts.

sam: yep. I'll add an explicit audit entry in the flag service. Draft API for force-off:

sam: ```bash
# force-off example
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/flags/acme_allowlist/deactivate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"reason":"canary rollback"}'
```

maria: Run the curl against staging first. Confirm the audit record shows: user, request_id, and timestamp.

lee: I'll post the suppression command in #eng-oncall when ready and tag @eng-oncall.

tanvi: Added checklist to docs: https://confluence/redwood/allowlist-rollbacks (staging steps, rollback owner, customer comm template).

alex: Perfect. sam/lee/tanvi — can you each sign off by EOD so I can schedule the enable? If no objections we'll proceed tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled — feature: enable acme_allowlist in prod — scheduled_by: alex — eta: 2024-07-25T16:00:00Z

sam: Signed off from my side, PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/flags/pull/412 — includes force-off endpoint and audit entry.

lee: Signed. alert suppression ready and linked in the runbook.

tanvi: Signed, written customer notification and support handoff.

alex: Thanks all. I'll create a 15-minute post-launch check-in slot on calendar and ping support 10m before.

maria: One more ask — can we ensure contract gating rule is in place so only ACME seat ids match the allowlist? Small test: run `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE contract_tier='acme_vip'` against staging.

sam: good call. added a preflight query to the checklist.

alex: OK closing this thread — proceed with the plan if signoffs remain. Report back in thread after enable. :rocket:
